Iris N.: Heads up - during the v2 soft-rollout we saw quota leakage: same token counts appearing in both v1 and v2 aggregates for a few tenants. Console quota alerts fired.

Cal J.: Yep. Quick root-cause: session affinity uses tenant+client-ip to pick a route, but the model router later sticky-allocates based on sequence length and can pick a different variant. Two different attributions recorded.

Rena K.: Example log:
2024-09-15T11:01:02Z routing: decision=affinity route=v1 tenant=old-payments trace=tr_9001
2024-09-15T11:01:02Z model-router: alloc=model-v2-quant trace=tr_9001
So route and model_variant disagree.

Tom B.: Short-term: console should hide per-route quota delta for any tenant with mismatch_rate > 0.5% and show a banner: "Attribution unstable." Also add a tiny "why" link with sample traces.

Iris N.: Longer-term fix: set a single canonical header X-Redwood-Route chosen at policy decision and make model-router read it rather than write attribution. Also emit metric handshake_mismatch_rate per-tenant.

Cal J.: Implementation plan:
- Routing: inject X-Redwood-Route (v1|v2|compat) before proxying.
- Model-router: do not overwrite X-Redwood-Route; instead set model_variant but tag driven_by_route=true.
- ETL: precedence: X-Redwood-Route -> route_tag -> model_variant. Default missing header to v1 for billing.
- Console: add preview mode that runs against canonicalized attribution only.
Estimate: routing + tests 4 hrs, model-router guard 2 hrs, ETL change + 1% validation backfill ~6 hrs, console mock 3 hrs.

ops-bot: Scheduled 1% validation backfill 03:00-03:30 UTC. Will page oncall if CPU > 70% or p99 latency > 200ms.

Rena K.: Owners: Iris (routing header PR), Cal (ETL precedence + backfill), Tom (console banner + preview), Rena (model-router guard). We'll gate further rollouts until mismatch_rate < 0.2%.

Iris N.: Opening PRs now and will update incident INC-2024-742 with progress. Thanks team.
